confidence_notes: Kota Kinabalu food and coffee estimates are supported by city-specific cost-of-living data. Alcohol prices are less certain because local samples are limited; the wine-glass estimate is inferred from its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and were not checked against current listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was needed for food and drink; those anchors use Kota Kinabalu-specific estimates. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on general Sabah and Southeast Asia travel-market knowledge.
